_about: Walther Amelung and Heinrich Holtzinger: The Museums and Ruins of Rome, English edition revised by the authors, ed. Mrs. S. Arthur Strong (2 vols., 1906; this printing 1912). Vol. I (museums) is Amelung's, vol. II (ruins) Holtzinger's. Classical scholarship (lane B, round dd). Raw IA OCR. No uids minted.
